snippet.title: DarkSwarm - Closed Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
DarkSwarm is an online co-op, top-down tactical shooter. Play as a team of elite operators in procedurally generated, semi-destructible levels. Use your skills, wits, and teamwork to destroy the alien DarkSwarm in daring operations deep inside the infested colonies.

SIGN UP FOR THE CLOSED ALPHA: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303200/DarkSwarm/

Developer
Bitfire Games

Publisher
Ghost Ship Publishing

Find out more:
https://darkswarm.com/
https://www.ghostship.dk/publishing/
